# SAICA-Bench

> SAICA-Bench (https://saica.ai) measures whether supervision tools and language models catch the typical failures of AI coding agents (11 failure modes, 9 measured on labelled data), scored J = TPR − FPR with cost per 1,000 reviews. This repository holds the benchmark, the SAICA-KG knowledge graph behind its taxonomy and tool catalog, and the website. Code Apache-2.0, data CC-BY-4.0.

The maintained llms.txt for the project is the site's: https://saica.ai/llms.txt (source: `site/public/llms.txt` in this repository). It lists the failure modes with definitions and page URLs, the key pages, the current results and the data files.

## Where things are in this repository

- `bench/`: one folder per failure mode (datasets, runners, scores); `bench/build_report.py` writes `site/public/bench/results.json`, the published results.
- `data/`: SAICA-KG, one YAML file per node (tools, failure modes, papers, incidents, taxonomies, crosswalks, recipes); counts in `data/MANIFEST.json`. Schemas in `schema/`; validate with `python validator/cli.py`.
- `site/`: the Astro site served at https://saica.ai; `pipeline/webapp.py` serves the built site plus the `/api/ask`, `/api/assess`, `/api/health` endpoints.
- `README.md`: overview and current results; `CITATION.cff`: how to cite.
